title: Ready-made refused when the index value is missing or old (row 12 gap G-12-1)
reference_behaviour: A preset is never refused for index staleness; it fails only when the server fails, with a generic failed-to-fetch toast.
ours: REQ-079 AC-8: the load is refused with the REQ-049 reason and no strike is placed from an old spot. Kept as stricter safety under ADR-015.
